title: Rocky's agent loop now runs on Claude
summary: Switched Rocky's agent loop to Claude Sonnet 4.5 with prompt caching, fixing document reading and calculation issues.

sections.heading: New
items: Agent loop runs on Claude Sonnet 4.5 via Anthropic SDK with prompt caching (Haiku 4.5 for scheduled jobs)
Monthly figures (Hausgeld, rent, loan) now tracked in finances/<propertyId>.json with get/set tools and scheduled effective_from dates

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Documents are now fully read (up to 20000 chars) instead of stopping at 5000, fixing incorrect Hausgeld calculations
Thread source tools store verbatim results and replay them on follow-ups so Rocky checks earlier replies against what it read
Calculator now keeps full precision instead of rounding ratios to cents
